amy (AE): Quick heads up 60 - Nebula Therapeutics sent a compact RFI. Asks: POC acceptance criteria, monthly reserved pricing, data processing terms, and a short tech preflight for their infra team. Can we compile answers?
devin (SE): Ill draft the POC acceptance criteria and the perf baseline. They want 200 qps gen and 500 reqs/min embed. Suggest a 2-week pilot with objective: embed p95 < 350ms and end-to-end gen p95 < 700ms.
nina (Solutions Eng): For 200 qps sustained, recommend Dedicated with 1.5x headroom. Practical monthly reserved price band: $18k-$28k depending on region and committed term. For trial offer 25% off the lower band.
amy (AE): Good. They also asked about telemetry access: can we provide model-level latency metrics and token counts per request during POC?
devin (SE): Yes  we can share per-route latency histograms and token accounting via the Console. We'll share a read-only dashboard link and exportable CSVs for the pilot.
omar (Security): On data handling: POC data is treated as ephemeral by default. We support a DPA addendum and a technical note: data-in-transit encrypted TLS1.2+, at-rest encryption on Dedicated/Private, and option to enable KV cache scrub on termination. Copy for RFI: 
```
Redwood treats pilot data as ephemeral unless explicitly retained. TLS-encrypted in flight; at-rest encryption via customer KMS or our managed keys. KV cache and temp storage are deleted at pilot end; logs can be redacted on request.
```
amy (AE): Perfect. They also flagged "auditability" for compliance team. Can we provide CloudTrail-compatible logs or an audit export?
omar (Security): We can provide structured audit logs with read/write events, model version changes, and KMS key usage events. Delivery via S3 export or API pull. Add: SOC2/ISO available.
devin (SE): Adding a short preflight checklist for their infra team: 
```
- Allow outbound 443 to api.redwood.ai and dedicated-region.redwood.ai
- Provide a static egress IP for tighter firewall rules (optional)
- Test health endpoint: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
- Verify TLS: openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.ai:443 -brief
```
nina (Solutions Eng): Important: we should propose canary strategy for their integration: 5% traffic to new model versions for 24h, then 25% for 48h, with rollback on degradations >5% accuracy drop or latency spike >30%.
amy (AE): Great. Legal asked about export controls and international data flow. Can we state we support region restrictions and that Private deployments can be fully air-gapped?
omar (Security): Yes. For hosted, we have region-specific deployments (NA, EU) and contractual guarantees on residency. Private supports air-gapped or on-premise installs; include a note: "We do not export customer data outside contracted regions without consent."
legal-bot: reminder: attach DPA template and standard SOW.
amy (AE): Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/nebula-rfi/ (contains capability matrix, DPA, SOW draft). Please add final commercial lines in the "pricing" tab.
devin (SE): Draft capability matrix rows: 
- Data Residency: "Region-specific hosted options (NA/EU); Private/on-prem available"
- KMS / HSM: "BYOK via Cloud KMS or KMIP HSM; audit logs for key usage"
- Observability: "Per-route metrics, token accounting, exportable audit logs"
- Rollout & Failover: "Canary rollouts, auto-fallback to compatible hosted model on Dedicated outage"
nina (Solutions Eng): Ill add latency and throughput cells plus the POC pricing bands.
amy (AE): One more commercial Q: They want an overage rate if they exceed reserved capacity during the pilot. Suggested: $0.12 per gen-token-equivalent overage; embedding overage $0.001 per embed.
nina (Solutions Eng): Agreeable. Mark pilot discount and milestone clause: extend at 50% usage sustained for 7 days -> discounted committed term applies.
amy (AE): Action items: devin = POC acceptance & preflight; nina = pricing bands + capability matrix; omar = security copy + DPA note. I'll assemble and ping legal for DPA redline by EOD. RFI-bot: RFI intake logged and assigned to amy (AE) due 2026-04-02.
amy (AE): Thanks team :raised_hands: Ill post the compiled response here when ready.
